quarterly_data.quarter: LG Innotek press release: LG Innotek Supplying Camera Modules for Zoox (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer Zoox (Amazon's autonomous driving subsidiary): building on a long-standing partnership, LG Innotek is expanding its collaboration with Zoox to supply automotive camera modules for the serial production of Zoox's purpose-built robotaxi fleet, which the company calls a major milestone in the multi-year relationship. Over the next several years Zoox vehicles will feature LG Innotek's high-resolution automotive cameras as part of the robotaxi sensor suite (overlapping field of view, 360-degree coverage); the waterproof modules come in five different fields of view depending on mounting position. The modules are currently being assembled onto Zoox robotaxis; the company says this positions it as a key supplier of core perception hardware.
